mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmItemDetailInfoModifyPopList*/ SELECT DECODE(A.CATEGORY_NO, NULL, '', (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE='PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID=A.CATEGORY_NO)) AS CATEG_NAME -- 0 , A.ITEM_NO AS ITEM_NO -- 1 , A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE -- 2 , A.CHANGE_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE -- 3 , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME -- 4 , DECODE(A.ITEM_STATUS, 'N', '진행 가능 상품', 'P', '단종', 'Q', '일시품절') AS ITEM_STATUS_TEXT -- 5 , A.ITEM_STATUS AS ITEM_STATUS -- 6 , A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION -- 7 , A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION -- 8 , A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME -- 9 , A.MAKER_PART_NO AS MAKER_PART_NO -- 10 , A.QUALITY AS QUALITY -- 11 , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_TEXT -- 12 , A.MIN_DELIVERY_LT MIN_DELIVERY_LT -- 13 , A.MAX_DELIVERY_LT MAX_DELIVERY_LT -- 14 , A.MAKE_LT MAKE_LT -- 15 , A.USER_PRICE USER_PRICE -- 16 , A.ITEM_QTY1 AS QTY1 -- 17 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE1 AS PRICE1 -- 18 , A.ITEM_QTY2 AS QTY2 -- 19 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE2 AS PRICE2 -- 20 , A.ITEM_QTY3 AS QTY3 -- 21 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE3 AS PRICE3 -- 22 , A.ITEM_QTY4 AS QTY4 -- 23 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE4 AS PRICE4 -- 24 , A.PRINT_OPT_PRICE AS PRINT_OPT_PRICE -- 25 , A.IMAGE_KEY -- 26 , NVL(A.REMARK, ' ') AS REMARK -- 27 , A.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE -- 28 , NVL(A.D_REMARK, ' ') AS D_REMARK -- 29 , NVL(A.B_REMARK, ' ') AS B_REMARK -- 30 , DECODE(A.IMG_NAME, NULL, 'NO_IMG', '/attfiles/'||A.IMG_DIR||'/'||A.IMG_NAME) AS IMG_PATH -- 31 , A.AGENT AS AGENT -- 32 , (SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE='PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID=A.CATEGORY_NO) AS CATEG_PATH -- 33 , A.CATEGORY_NO -- 34 , DECODE(A.STATUS, 'S', '요청', 'C', '게시', 'B', '반려', 'R','게시', 'A','보관', 'D','삭제','V','추천') AS STATUS -- 35 , DECODE(A.ITEM_FLAG, 'N', '일반', 'G','기획') AS GUBUN -- 36 , DECODE(NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0),0,1,NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0)) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY -- 37 , A.IMAGE_KEY FROM PRMTITEM A WHERE A.ITEM_NO = #{ITEM_NO}
